hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$ROOT" ]; then node "$ROOT/hooks/chief-of-staff-hook.js" session; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $root = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($root -and (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { node (Join-Path $root 'hooks\chief-of-staff-hook.js') session }
